ws_description: Bring your Chrome session into the sites you use.
ws_settings_desc: Turn on “Pull from Chrome” per site. With the switch off the site asks for a sign-in inside the app.
ws_toggle_hint: Turning the switch off erases that site's session; the site asks for a sign-in again.
ws_google_drive_note: One Google account is one session, so turning this switch off also signs the Google Drive panel out.
ws_clear_all_hint: Only the sites whose import switch is on are cleared; a session you signed into inside the app is kept. The switches stay on, so the sessions are pulled again at the next round.
ws_status_extension_missing: The Chrome extension is not installed.
ws_status_extension_outdated: The Chrome extension is outdated; reload it.
ws_status_permission_missing: The extension has no permission for this site.
ws_status_no_cookies_in_browser: No session for this site was found in Chrome.
ws_status_imported: The session was pulled from Chrome.
ws_status_import_failed: The session could not be pulled.
ws_status_signed_out: No session; sign in inside the app.
ws_error_unknown_target: The app does not know this site.
ws_error_write_failed: The setting could not be saved.
ws_error_wipe_failed: The session could not be cleared.
ws_error_import_failed: The session was not imported; no cookie could be written.
ws_error_packet_too_large: The session was too big to transfer; Chrome sent more cookies than the bridge accepts.
ws_error_switch_off_wipe_failed: The switch was turned off but the session could not be cleared.
ws_error_web_dev_mode_only: This action is only available in the desktop app.
ws_warning_intro: This feature uses a shared web session and browser-profile persistence instead of an official API. Review the following risks before you use it.
ws_risk_unofficial: This is not an official integration; the flow can break suddenly when the site changes its behaviour.
ws_risk_challenge: Security steps (2FA, verification, captcha/challenge) may be triggered unexpectedly.
ws_risk_expiry: Session cookies can expire or be invalidated; periodic reauthentication may be required.
ws_risk_profile_access: The web session is stored in a local profile; shared devices can increase privacy exposure.
ws_risk_behavior_changes: If the session cookies or the sign-in pages change, the automatic detection and health check may produce wrong results.
ws_risk_multi_device: Device/IP/network changes can cause sign-out events or forced reauthentication.
ws_mitigation_dedicated_profile: Prefer a dedicated account/profile for this feature when possible.
ws_mitigation_stable_network: Use the same device and a stable network whenever possible.
ws_mitigation_manual_reauth: Do not expect automatic bypass for security prompts; reauthenticate manually.
ws_mitigation_no_shared_machine: Do not leave this feature enabled on shared machines.
ws_official_warning: This workflow is based on shared web-session persistence and is not an official API integration.
ws_extension_status_waiting: Waiting for Chrome extension connection... Make sure Chrome is running and the extension is enabled.
ws_extension_status_waiting_long: Still waiting. Open chrome://extensions and verify the Quizlab extension is enabled and loaded.
ws_extension_wizard_risk_desc: The Chrome extension requires access to your session cookies. Review the risks below:
ws_extension_wizard_install_desc: The extension will be installed and configured for use with Quizlab.
ws_extension_wizard_remove_desc: This will delete the extension files and bridge configuration from your computer.
ws_extension_wizard_remove_success_desc: Extension files have been deleted successfully.
ws_extension_wizard_remove_manual_step1: 1. Copy 'chrome://extensions' and paste it in Chrome's address bar.
ws_extension_wizard_remove_manual_step2: 2. Find the 'Quizlab Site Session Bridge' extension.
